checks: Only frozen organizers may establish explicitly reviewed objects and actual non-future offline opening evidence
One session creates separate sheets from exact frozen duties and never treats organizer or wildcard privilege as scoring identity
Independent task APIs reject outsiders and foreign tenants despite administrator permissions
Partial drafts survive while invalid ranges, duplicate cells, foreign duties and incomplete submissions are blocked
A project read-only member with explicit review permission may save only personal opinions without generic project management rights
Client-supplied evaluator identities cannot replace the login identity and personal reads never include another member’s drafts
Explicit personal submission locks the original revision and concurrent retries submit exactly once
Organizers see completion state but no other person’s opinion values
Missing published correction workflow rolls back the application without unlocking submitted opinions
A real Flowable correction freezes the exact original hash and limited cells without publishing full scoring data
Approved correction creates the owner’s next draft, blocks out-of-scope changes, and preserves the old submitted bytes and hash
Rejected and personally withdrawn corrections leave the previous submitted opinion locked
Wildcard administrators cannot approve their own correction even if the workflow names them
Confidentiality and active-account revocation immediately protect personal tasks even with an existing login token
Voided rules stop further writes while historical personal submissions remain readable and unchanged
scope: synthetic offline-opening evidence and independent manual opinions; no ranking, award or legal certification
